issue.title: test_flags_pane_enable_and_disable_write_state_and_request_restart hits its 5s restart wait under the full lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-14n.13 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1), filed by the sase-14n land agent. On 2026-09-20 the phase's full check lane (13772 passed) failed this node on its 5s wait_for for the restart request. It then passed in isolation in 11s on the same tree. The phase diff (notification undismiss) does not touch the feature-flags pane. Observed fail rate: 1 failure under the full lane, 0 in isolation. Related but not the same node: sase-12c (feature-flag toggle restart duplicate suppression).
